text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki has a dance rehearsal
today.
Although she approaches the
rehearsal with great
determination...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm?! I'm so sorry! I've done it again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's dance starts off well,
but as she
spins she gets overexcited
and ends up
repeatedly striking at
empty air.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please excuse that display... Dance and
martial
arts share common principles, so
I thought it
would be simpler to perform
my dance like I
would a martial arts kata.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But that was a dangerous pitfall. I got so
involved
that, before I knew it, visions of
enemies were
appearing before me one
after another!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please... let me try again! This time, I'll
be sure to
quell the fierce blaze within
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This might actually be a serious problem.
If her
fierce blaze is left unchecked and
spirals out of
control mid-performance...
choice_data_list: ちょ、ちょっと一旦休憩！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaa... Osu!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Good heavens! She took out everyone
onstage in
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no telling what could happen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I put too much strength into
each
movement, and that affords my
killer instinct an
opening. I was warned
about it often at the
dojo...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If only I could ease my strength and
move with
more fluidity!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see! I'll sway like a willow in the breeze
and
evade without a thought to
countering!
choice_data_list: 敵の攻撃を受け流すイメージで
想定する敵を……100倍に増やそう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's multiply our hypothetical enemies... by a hundred!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This approach should prove useful in my
martial
arts training as well. Thank you! I
feel like a path
forward has opened.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Okay! Now, I have a favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to try to strike me while I'm
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It will be far more effective than with
imagination
alone. And I'm sure I'll learn
a lot if I'm able to get
through it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't hold back! Come at me with
all your
might!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I also end up exhausted,
Yaeno Muteki
successfully learns to
move as fluidly as water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? Wouldn't that result in an
even greater
loss of control?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now I see! With that many enemies,
I'd have
no means of combating them
all, and no choice
but to let them flow
by!
choice_data_list: だが……限界まで余裕を失くせば？
でも……限界まで余裕を失くせば？
choice_data_list_en: But... what if she's pushed to the limit and loses all composure?
Still... what if you're pushed so far you lose all composure?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A ground-shattering idea... I knew you
would
deliver, Trainer! Let's start
training immediately!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now, to focus!

text_block_list.name: Illusory Warrior Legion
text_block_list.text:
Muahaha! How foolish that you would
knock so
willingly on death's door!
Behold our unstoppable
power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not a single one of your strikes will land!

Awaken, water still!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While presumably conjuring the mental
image of
a hundred enemies, Yaeno
Muteki performs a
gorgeous and elegant
dance... With that
challenge overcome,
we get ready to face many
more!
